claims.claim: When an autonomous agent needs to invoke an Auth0 flow or debug a flow execution failure, this material kit provides the exact endpoint URLs, error codes, and callback schemas so the agent can correctly call the flow and handle errors without guessing
source_facts_needed: Exact Auth0 flow execution endpoint URLs and their HTTP methods
Specific HTTP status codes and error codes for flow execution failures
Exact debugger API endpoint and its request/response schema
